evidence.title: Africa Data Centres breaks ground on new Sameer facility in Nairobi
evidence.excerpt: Africa Data Centres reports that it officially broke ground on an additional modular facility in Nairobi, beginning with 5 MW of IT load and expandable by up to an extra 15 MW of IT load.
